h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gurgaon

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gurgaon

c: Corporate campuses in Gurgaon, now Gurugram, often have landscaped grounds that staff walk through but seldom use. An open-air gym on that lawn gives employees a reason to step out during a break. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to office campuses, condominium towers, RWA parks and schools across Gurgaon. Our machines are made in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,090 km away, and travel to Haryana by road.

An office gym is used in short bursts before work, at lunch and after the evening shift, so the stations need to be quick to understand. Our machines use the person's own body weight and need no instruction card or adjustment. Either our own fitters or a dealer from north India will fix them, grouted or on a self-standing base. Send us the campus plan and photos, and we will mark the gym area, the walking access and the clear space for each machine on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on a landscaped office lawn?
items.a: Yes. We grout the bases into the ground or use a self-standing base where digging is not allowed. Our layout drawing shows the exact spots so your garden team can plan around them.

items.q: Which machines suit busy office staff?
items.a: Machines that work several muscles at once, such as a rower, ski trainer or multi gym, give a useful session in a short break. They need no setup between users.

items.q: Do you supply condominium towers in Gurgaon?
items.a: Yes. We supply outdoor gym equipment to residential towers and RWA parks as well as offices. Send the site size and photos, and we will suggest machines and a layout.
